# The estimating skill ships with the client, not with the organization's
# knowledge: it describes how to drive THIS binary, so versioning it with the
# commands it invokes is the only way the two cannot disagree.

mkdir $WORK/proj

# It installs even into a workspace that has synced nothing at all.
fulcrum skills install $WORK/proj
grep 'installed estimating-with-fulcrum' last-stdout.txt

# It reaches every harness a project might drive — Claude Code, the
# vendor-neutral SKILL.md directory, and the AGENTS.md managed block.
exists proj/.claude/skills/estimating-with-fulcrum/SKILL.md
exists proj/.skills/estimating-with-fulcrum/SKILL.md
grep 'estimating-with-fulcrum' proj/AGENTS.md

# It carries the rules that keep a local estimate honest.
grep 'Never compute the committed hours yourself' proj/.claude/skills/estimating-with-fulcrum/SKILL.md
grep 'Never emit an `hours` field' proj/.claude/skills/estimating-with-fulcrum/SKILL.md
grep 'fulcrum context --project' proj/.claude/skills/estimating-with-fulcrum/SKILL.md

# And it is pinned like any other installed skill.
grep 'estimating-with-fulcrum' proj/.fulcrum/.fulcrum-installed.json

# A sync alongside it installs both, and neither displaces the other.
fulcrum sync
fulcrum skills install $WORK/proj
grep 'installed corpus-writing-specs' last-stdout.txt
grep 'installed estimating-with-fulcrum' last-stdout.txt
exists proj/.claude/skills/corpus-writing-specs/SKILL.md
exists proj/.claude/skills/estimating-with-fulcrum/SKILL.md
